newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gold-Zack to resume dividend payouts.
newsitem.headline: Gold-Zack to resume dividend payouts.

text.p: German textile group Gold-Zack AG plans to resume dividend payouts as its earnings situation in 1996 was positive, the group said in a regulatory statement on Tuesday.
The group plans a dividend payout of 50 pfennigs per five mark share for 1996 and said it also plans capital raise to 17.82 million marks from 14.85 million marks, on a one-for-five basis.

Gold-Zack said the group saw net profits of 6.1 million marks in 1996 and 6.5 million marks at parent level. Three million marks would be set aside for retained earnings, the group said in a statement.
Earnings were strongly influenced in the previous year by extraordinary revenues from restructuring in the group.
